```{r}
library(FlowSOM)
library(EmbedSOM)
library(uwot)
```

```{r}
#| label: Load gatingSet
gs_save_path <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  "PT_GatingSet_20261109_223337" # change to something more durable later
)
PT_gs <- load_gs(gs_save_path)
```


```{r}
#| label: Inspect gatingSet

pData(PT_gs)
markernames(PT_gs)
gs_get_pop_paths(PT_gs, path = "auto")
plot(PT_gs)
```


```{r}
#| label: gated samples into a clenaed FlowSet

cleaned_cs <- gs_pop_get_data(PT_gs, "singlets", inverse.transform = FALSE)
class(cleaned_cs)
cleaned_fs <- cytoset_to_flowSet(cleaned_cs)
markernames(cleaned_fs)
```


```{r}
#| label: Try with first sample

ff <- cleaned_fs[[1]]
cols_to_use <- colnames(ff)[
  !str_detect(
    string = colnames(ff),
    pattern = "SSC|FSC|AF|Helix|Live Dead|PE-Cy7|Time|ID"
  )
]


fSOM <- FlowSOM(
  input = ff,
  compensate = FALSE,
  transform = FALSE,
  colsToUse = cols_to_use,
  nClus = 15,
  seed = set.seed(36)
)
star <- PlotStars(
  fsom = fSOM,
  backgroundValues = fSOM$metaclustering
)

FlowSOMmary(fSOM)

# try with FlowSet

fSOM_flowset <- FlowSOM(
  cleaned_fs,
  compensate = FALSE,
  transform = FALSE,
  colsToUse = cols_to_use,
  nClus = 15
)

FlowSOMmary(fSOM_flowset, plotFile = NULL)
```


```{r}
#| label: EmbedSOM

input_data <- fSOM_flowset$data

embed_som <- EmbedSOM(
  fsom = fSOM,
  parallel = TRUE
)

PlotEmbed(embed_som)

gqt_embed_som_map <- GQTSOM(input_data, parallel = T)
embed_gqt <- EmbedSOM(input_data, map = gqt_embed_som_map, parallel = T)
PlotEmbed(embed_gqt)
```

Let's try the `Spectre` [package](https://immunedynamics.io/Spectre/articles/simple_discovery.html)


```{r}
pak::pkg_install("immunedynamics/Spectre")
library(Spectre)
```


```{r}
#| label: demo set for spectre

cell.dat <- Spectre::demo.clustered
cell.dat <- cell.dat[, 1:19]
cell.dat <- do.subsample(dat = cell.dat, targets = 10000)

str(cell.dat)
dim(cell.dat)

# See col numbers
as.matrix(names(cell.dat))

cluster_cols <- names(cell.dat)[11:19] # all transformed cols
as.matrix(cluster_cols)
```


```{r}
#| label: clustering with Spectre

cell.dat <- run.flowsom(
  dat = cell.dat,
  use.cols = cluster_cols,
  xdim = 10,
  ydim = 10,
  max.meta = 20
)

glimpse(cell.dat) # check flowsom attached
```


```{r}
#| label: UMAP with spectre

cell.dat <- run.umap(
  dat = cell.dat,
  use.cols = cluster_cols
)
glimpse(cell.dat)
```

factor plot = UMAP as axis and FlowSOM metaclusters as color overlay

```{r}
#| label: lets visualize

make.colour.plot(
  dat = cell.dat,
  x.axis = "UMAP_X",
  y.axis = "UMAP_Y",
  col.axis = "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  col.type = "factor",
  add.label = TRUE,
  save.to.disk = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
#| label: function to write back to a csv and or fcs file

withr::with_dir(
  output_folder,
  write.files(
    dat = cell.dat,
    file.prefix = "Spectre practice",
    write.csv = TRUE,
    write.fcs = TRUE
  )
)
```

back to plotting!!


```{r}
make.multi.plot(
  dat = cell.dat,
  x.axis = "UMAP_X",
  y.axis = "UMAP_Y",
  plot.by = cluster_cols,
  path = output_folder
)

# Expression heatmap

exp <- do.aggregate(cell.dat, cluster_cols, by = "FlowSOM_metacluster")
make.pheatmap(
  dat = exp,
  sample.col = "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  plot.cols = cluster_cols,
  path = NULL
)
```

At this point is a good time to annotate clusters... make a script for that?

Using the example:

```{r}
annotate_spectre <- list(
  "CD4 T Cells" = c(4),
  "Neutrophils" = c(2),
  "Microglia" = c(1),
  "CD 8 T cells" = c(3),
  "Infil Mactophages" = c(5)
)
annotate_spectre <- do.list.switch(annotate_spectre)
names(annotate_spectre) <- c("Values", "Population")
setorderv(annotate_spectre, "Values")

annotate_spectre
```

add to the other data

```{r}
cell.dat <- do.add.cols(
  cell.dat,
  base.col = "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  add.dat = annotate_spectre,
  add.by = "Values"
)

glimpse(cell.dat)
```

LEt's view by the labels:

```{r}
make.colour.plot(
  cell.dat,
  "UMAP_X",
  "UMAP_Y",
  "Population",
  col.type = 'factor',
  add.label = TRUE,
  path = output_folder
)

exp <- do.aggregate(cell.dat, cluster_cols, by = "Population")
make.pheatmap(exp, "Population", cluster_cols, path = output_folder)
```

write annotated csv...

## Data Example

Cool now with our data..


```{r}
#| label: Load gatingSet and put cleaned data into a data.table
gs_save_path <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  "PT_GatingSet_20261109_223337" # change to something more durable later
)
PT_gs <- load_gs(gs_save_path)


pData(PT_gs)
markernames(PT_gs)
gs_get_pop_paths(PT_gs, path = "auto")

cleaned_data <- gs_pop_get_data(PT_gs, "singlets", inverse.transform = FALSE)

samples_names <- sampleNames(PT_gs) # Add RegEx PT extract IDs to pData in a scipt to make ID easier

data_list <- map(samples_names, \(sample_id) {
  pop_data <- exprs(cleaned_data[[sample_id]])
  dt <- as.data.table(pop_data)
  dt[, Sample := sample_id]
  return(dt)
})

glimpse(data_list)

data <- rbindlist(data_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

as.matrix(names(data))
```


```{r}
#| label: tidy and prepare variables

marker_cols <- names(data)[11:27]
sample_col <- names(data)[31]
cluster_cols <- names(data)[c(11:22, 24, 25)] # no scatter, viability, DNA, or CD45
```

Great, now that's tidy let's get to work!


```{r}
#| label: flowsom

Spectre_output_folder <- file.path(output_folder, "Spectre_outputs")
dir.create(Spectre_output_folder)

data <- run.flowsom(
  dat = data,
  use.cols = cluster_cols,
  xdim = 10,
  ydim = 10,
  meta.k = 15
)

glimpse(data)
```


```{r}
#| label: UMAP; with subsampled samples

# subsample for DimRed
## number of cells per sample
data |> nrow()

## lets make the sample a factor col
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    Sample = as_factor(Sample)
  )

## groupby Sample
data |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  count()

## let's downsample to an even amount per sample
set.seed(12)
data_subsample <- data |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5000) |>
  ungroup() |>
  as.data.table()

## let's check
data_subsample |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  count()

data_subsample <- run.umap(
  dat = data_subsample,
  use.cols = cluster_cols,
  umap.seed = 12
)
glimpse(data_subsample)
```

And visualize

```{r}
#| label: visualize

make.colour.plot(
  data_subsample,
  "UMAP_X",
  "UMAP_Y",
  col.axis = "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  col.type = "factor",
  add.label = TRUE,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)

flowsom_clusters <- do.aggregate(data, cluster_cols, by = "FlowSOM_metacluster")
make.pheatmap(
  flowsom_clusters,
  "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  cluster_cols,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)
```

should rename the colnames so its easier to read heatmap.
# THIS EXAMPLE!

```{r}
#| label: Load gatingSet and put cleaned data into a data.table
gs_save_path <- file.path(
  output_folder,
  "PT_GatingSet_20261109_223337" # change to something more durable later
)
PT_gs <- load_gs(gs_save_path)


pData(PT_gs)
markernames(PT_gs)
gs_get_pop_paths(PT_gs, path = "auto")

cleaned_data <- gs_pop_get_data(PT_gs, "singlets", inverse.transform = FALSE)

samples_names <- sampleNames(PT_gs) # Add RegEx PT extract IDs to pData in a scipt to make ID easier

data_list <- map(samples_names, \(sample_id) {
  pop_data <- exprs(cleaned_data[[sample_id]])
  dt <- as.data.table(pop_data)
  dt[, Sample := sample_id]
  return(dt)
})

glimpse(data_list)

data <- rbindlist(data_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

as.matrix(names(data))
```

```{r}
markers <- markernames(PT_gs)
fluorophores <- intersect(names(markers), names(data))

data.table::setnames(
  data,
  old = fluorophores,
  new = unname(markers[fluorophores])
)

names(data)
```

Let's rerun the analysis with these names:


```{r}
marker_cols <- names(data)[11:27]
sample_col <- names(data)[31]
cluster_cols <- names(data)[c(11:22, 24, 25)] # no scatter, viability, DNA, or CD45
```


```{r}
Spectre_output_folder <- file.path(output_folder, "Spectre_outputs")
dir.create(Spectre_output_folder)

data <- run.flowsom(
  dat = data,
  use.cols = cluster_cols,
  xdim = 10,
  ydim = 10,
  meta.k = 15,
)
glimpse(data)


# subsample for DimRed
## number of cells per sample
data |> nrow()

## lets make the sample a factor col
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    Sample = as_factor(Sample)
  )

## groupby Sample
data |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  count()

## let's downsample to an even amount per sample
set.seed(12)
data_subsample <- data |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  slice_sample(n = 5000) |>
  ungroup() |>
  as.data.table()

## let's check
data_subsample |>
  group_by(Sample) |>
  count()

data_subsample <- run.umap(
  dat = data_subsample,
  use.cols = cluster_cols,
  umap.seed = 12
)

glimpse(data_subsample)
```


```{r}
make.multi.plot(
  data_subsample,
  "UMAP_X",
  "UMAP_Y",
  plot.by = cluster_cols,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)

make.colour.plot(
  data_subsample,
  "UMAP_X",
  "UMAP_Y",
  col.axis = "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  col.type = "factor",
  add.label = TRUE,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)

flowsom_clusters <- do.aggregate(data, cluster_cols, by = "FlowSOM_metacluster")
make.pheatmap(
  flowsom_clusters,
  "FlowSOM_metacluster",
  cluster_cols,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)
```

summary table

```{r}
markers <- data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cluster_cols), # marker column names
    names_to = "Marker",
    values_to = "Expression"
  )

glimpse(markers)

p <- ggplot(
  data = markers,
  aes(x = Expression, y = FlowSOM_metacluster, fill = FlowSOM_metacluster)
) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(
    scale = 0.9,
    rel_min_height = 0.01,
    alpha = 0.8,
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Marker, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x = "Marker expression",
    y = "Metacluster",
    title = "Marker distribution by Metacluster"
  ) +
  ggridges::theme_ridges() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p

ggsave(
  "Marker distribution by metacluster.png",
  plot = p,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)
```


```{r}
cluster_events <- data |>
  group_by(FlowSOM_metacluster, Sample) |>
  count()

p <- ggplot(
  cluster_events,
  aes(x = FlowSOM_metacluster, y = n, fill = FlowSOM_metacluster)
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~Sample) +
  labs(
    title = "Events per metacluster per patient",
    x = "Metacluster",
    y = "Number of Events",
    fill = "Metacluster"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  "Events per metacluster per patient.png",
  p,
  path = Spectre_output_folder
)
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(data_subsample, aes(UMAP_X, UMAP_Y, color = FlowSOM_metacluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~Sample) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(color = "Cluster")

ggsave("Patient UMAPs.png", p, path = Spectre_output_folder)
```


```{r}
markers <- data_subsample |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cluster_cols),
    names_to = "Marker",
    values_to = "Expression"
  )

p <- ggplot(markers, aes(UMAP_X, UMAP_Y)) +
  stat_summary_hex(
    aes(z = Expression, fill = after_stat(value)),
    bins = 128,
    fun = median
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Marker) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Median Expression") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(title = "Marker Expression")

ggsave("UMAP Marker Expression.png", p, path = Spectre_output_folder)
```
